description: This file contains unit tests for the MacGatewayChatTransport mapping functions, verifying that various event frames and snapshot data are correctly mapped to internal models used within the OpenClaw chat application.

methods.name: snapshot maps to health
methods.description: Tests that a snapshot event is correctly mapped to a health model with health status false.

methods.name: health event maps to health
methods.description: Tests that a health event frame is correctly mapped to a health model with health status true.

methods.name: tick event maps to tick
methods.description: Tests that a tick event frame is correctly mapped to a tick enumeration.

methods.name: chat event maps to chat
methods.description: Tests that a chat event frame with specific payload fields is correctly mapped to a chat model with matching properties.

methods.name: unknown event maps to nil
methods.description: Verifies that an unrecognized event type results in a nil mapping.

methods.name: seq gap maps to seq gap
methods.description: Checks that a sequence gap indicator is correctly mapped to the seqGap enumeration.
